short_description:
GTA 6 Sahara Arena location: it's labelled on Rockstar's official map in Downtown Vice City, on the bay east of Crosstown, the same spot Miami's Kaseya Center (home of the Miami Heat) holds in real life. Fan guides and GTA Wiki call it GTA 6's Kaseya Center (Rockstar hasn't said so). In real life, on November 18, 2026, the Heat hosted "A Night in Vice City" at Kaseya Center: Vice City jerseys (Nike, Cactus Jack, Rockstar) and a Vice City court. No story spoilers.

📍 Map Spot #8 of our GTA 6 map series: every spot is in the playlist "GTA 6 Map: Where to Find It".

Sources: Rockstar Games (official map), NBA.com (Miami Heat), ABC7/AP, GTABoom, GTA Wiki, Yardbarker, GTA6 Intel.

El Sahara Arena de GTA 6 está en el mapa oficial de Rockstar: Downtown Vice City, junto a la bahía, al este de Crosstown, justo donde está el Kaseya Center de los Miami Heat en la vida real. Las guías de fans y la GTA Wiki lo llaman el Kaseya Center de GTA 6 (Rockstar no lo ha dicho). Y en la vida real, el 18 de noviembre de 2026, los Heat jugaron "A Night in Vice City" en el Kaseya Center con camisetas y cancha de Vice City (Nike, Cactus Jack y Rockstar). Sin spoilers.
